architecture: per-frame linear+relu; conv1d+relu x2 (same padding, batch norm folded); global average and max pooling concatenated; linear to logits
weights: float32 little-endian, tensors in the order above, row-major; conv weight is [out][in][kernel]
feature_spec: MediaPipe Holistic normalised image points, unmirrored; y scaled by height/width; centre = mean shoulder midpoint (pose 11, 12) over the segment, scale = mean shoulder width; per frame: left hand 21x(x,y), right hand 21x(x,y), pose 11..16 (x,y), left and right presence flags; a missing part is zeros; segment resampled to `frames` by nearest index (i*(n-1)*2 + frames-1) div (2*(frames-1))
dataset: Multimodal ISL alphabet photographs (CC BY 4.0, doi:10.17632/2tj6c7pzfk.1) plus the app's ISL letter and digit keyframes posed on the rig; tested on ISLAN signers (doi:10.17632/rc349j45m5.1)
